meta.description: Welpco code of conduct for Clients and Welpers.

hero.title: Welpco Code of Conduct
hero.intro: At Welpco, we are committed to creating a safe, respectful, and trustworthy platform for both Clients and Welpers. Everyone using Welpco is expected to follow this Code of Conduct when communicating, booking, providing, or receiving services through the platform.

blocks.text: All users must treat each other with respect, professionalism, and courtesy.
Users must not engage in:

items: Harassment, intimidation, threats, or abusive language
Discrimination based on age, gender, race, religion, disability, sexual orientation, nationality, or any other protected characteristic
Inappropriate, sexual, offensive, or disrespectful comments
Bullying, pressure, or manipulation

blocks.text: Welpco has zero tolerance for behaviour that makes another user feel unsafe or uncomfortable.
Clients and Welpers must act in a way that protects their own safety and the safety of others.
Users must not:

items: Request or perform unsafe, illegal, or inappropriate tasks
Bring unauthorized individuals to a job without prior approval
Enter private areas that are not related to the requested service
Share personal information unnecessarily outside the platform
Use the platform for dating, personal relationships, or any purpose unrelated to services

blocks.text: If a user ever feels unsafe, they should leave the situation immediately and contact Welpco.
All users must provide truthful and accurate information when creating a profile, booking a service, or communicating through the platform.
Users must not:

items: Create fake profiles
Misrepresent their identity, experience, skills, availability, or qualifications
Use another person's account
Provide false payment, contact, or verification information

blocks.text: Welpco may suspend or remove any account that contains misleading or false information.
All communication between Clients and Welpers should remain professional and related to the service.
Users must:

items: Communicate clearly and respectfully
Respond in a timely manner when possible
Keep all service-related communication on the Welpco platform when available
Avoid spam, excessive messages, or inappropriate requests

blocks.text: Clients and Welpers are expected to respect confirmed bookings.

items: Arrive on time
Be prepared to complete the agreed service
Notify the Client as soon as possible if they are delayed or unable to attend
Complete the service professionally and to the best of their ability
Provide accurate service details
Be available at the scheduled time
Provide a safe and respectful environment
Pay through the Welpco platform as required

blocks.text: Repeated cancellations, no-shows, or unreliable behaviour may result in account restrictions.
All payments must be completed through the Welpco platform unless otherwise authorized by Welpco.
Users must not:

items: Try to avoid platform fees
Request cash payments for services booked through Welpco
Encourage another user to complete the transaction outside the platform
Use the platform to promote unrelated businesses, products, or services

blocks.text: Violating payment rules may result in suspension or removal from the platform.
Users must respect each other's privacy.
Users must not:

items: Share another user's personal information without permission
Take photos, videos, or recordings without consent
Post about another user or a service experience online in a way that identifies them without permission
Misuse contact information obtained through Welpco

blocks.text: Welpers must treat Clients' homes, property, pets, and belongings with care and respect.
Clients must also respect the personal belongings, tools, and equipment of Welpers.
Any damage, loss, or incident should be reported as soon as possible.
The following behaviours are strictly prohibited on Welpco:

items: Violence, threats, harassment, or intimidation
Sexual misconduct or inappropriate behaviour
Fraud, theft, or dishonesty
Illegal activity
Discrimination or hate speech
Drug or alcohol impairment during a service
Unsafe work conditions
Requests for services that are illegal, dangerous, or inappropriate
Attempts to bypass the Welpco platform for payment or communication in bad faith

blocks.text: Reviews must be honest, respectful, and based on a real service experience.
Users must not:

items: Leave fake reviews
Threaten negative reviews to pressure another user
Use offensive, discriminatory, or defamatory language
Share private information in a review

blocks.text: Welpco may remove reviews that violate this Code of Conduct.
Welpco may investigate reports of misconduct and may take action at its discretion, including:

items: Issuing a warning
Temporarily restricting access
Removing content or reviews
Suspending or closing an account
Reporting serious incidents to the appropriate authorities, when necessary

blocks.text: Users are encouraged to report any behaviour that violates this Code of Conduct or makes them feel unsafe.
To report a concern, contact Welpco at:
support@welpco.com
Welpco will review reports and take appropriate action based on the situation.
By using Welpco, all users agree to help maintain a respectful, safe, and reliable community. Trust is essential to the Welpco experience, and every Client and Welper plays a role in protecting it.
